scope: Isolated complete modeled MemX; original continuous baseline vs exact-advance adapter. Matched50MHz/negative-edge external input stage then positive-edge launch/capture shell/20ns embedded paths/2ns max0ns min virtual I/O; counts include shell/pruning. Small-file scan outputs require every consumer held externally; no global barrier, physical machine snapshot or speed claim.

manifest.scope: Complete modeled frozen native64K-map MemX; every socket history independent,2-state. No external/global barrier,device/ARM state or physical machine snapshot
